name: raven
description: A live preview pane beside the transcript: the session's diff with review comments, and rendered plans and docs as Claude writes them.

watchedPaths.title: Watched doc paths
watchedPaths.description: Comma-separated path fragments; a landed edit whose path contains one opens the Doc view.

autoOpen.title: Open panes automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the diff on the first edit, plans as they are written and the task list as it starts. Off: panes open only when asked.

keyboardControls.title: Keyboard controls
keyboardControls.description: Draw plain Tab-reachable buttons instead of interactive pills.

autoOpenColumns.title: Auto-open minimum width
autoOpenColumns.description: Skip auto-open below this terminal width, in columns.

cardStyle.title: Card style
cardStyle.description: How files, doc sections, the compose box and tables are framed: bar (default), none, sharp or rounded.

splitColumns.title: Side-by-side minimum width
splitColumns.description: Show the diff side by side at or above this pane width, in columns, unless the header chip forced a mode.

paneBackground.title: Pane background
paneBackground.description: A colour painted behind every Raven pane, so the pane matches your terminal (#rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(r, g, b) or a theme colour name; for example #101315). Empty: the engine's own pane colour.
